|------------------------------------------|----------------------|---------------|-------------------|

| **Yuji Itadori** (also listed as a “second‑year” in the later seasons) | **Yuki Kaji** | 22 April 1984 | **41 years** |

### A quick note on the “second‑year” designation

In the original manga and the first season of the anime, Yuta and Yuji are **first‑year** students (Class 1‑A).  After the events of the first season, the story progresses into a new school year, and the manga/second‑season animation sometimes refer to them as “second‑year” (Class 2‑A).  The ages above reflect the current ages of the voice actors at the time the question was asked (early 2025), not the in‑story ages of the characters.
